subject.why: The six-wheeled rover is clearly recognizable with all requested elements included.

category.why: Firmly positioned on a wide sand band with a low heroic camera angle.

clean.why: Free of text, watermarks, UI, and characters.

framing.why: Well-centered with solid margins around the silhouette.

colour.why: Saturated palette with strong separation between subject and pink sky.

detail.why: Appropriately stylized without noisy textures or clutter.

style.why: Matches reference rendering with chunky forms and satin sheen.
